failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: Cost dashboard's CONTEXT EFFICIENCY test asserts on loop.context_efficiency event data, but the test's cost-entries fixture (last 30 days) is empty, so the dashboard reports 'No cost entries' instead of rendering the expected section
failures.fix: Seed a cost entry (or mock costs.json) with a recent timestamp in the sw-cost-test.sh fixture setup before invoking the dashboard so the 30-day lookback window is non-empty

failures.root_cause: Pipeline E2E tests fail because plan.md/review.md artifacts aren't written to .claude/pipeline-artifacts/, cascading into dependent tests (full E2E, resume, cleanup) and low-complexity intelligence skip test
failures.fix: Verify the plan/review stage functions write artifacts to the expected .claude/pipeline-artifacts/ path in sw-pipeline.sh before the E2E test checks for them

failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test failed because a stale pipeline lock from a prior run left status=running, blocking the new pipeline; sw-loop-test and sw-intent-analysis-test failed on unrelated assertions (loop stuckness detection, intent schema missing required fields)
failures.fix: clear/reset the stale pipeline lock before the e2e-integration test run (or add lock cleanup in test setup/teardown), and separately fix intent analysis schema to include version/goal/criteria and investigate the loop stuckness detection logic

failures.root_cause: Test suite output is a clean full-pass log with no failing assertions or error trace present
failures.fix: Re-run the test stage in isolation and capture actual stderr/exit code; suite pass/fail counts show 0 failures so investigate CI harness/log truncation instead of test code

failures.root_cause: Real Shipwright data smoke test computed a composite reward of N/A instead of a numeric value, likely from a missing/null field in quality-scores.jsonl or stage-effectiveness.jsonl breaking the reward aggregator's math
failures.fix: Add a null/empty-field guard in the reward composite calculation (reward-aggregator.sh) so it defaults missing components instead of propagating N/A, and assert numeric output in the smoke test
